|appeared = {{amol|18}}|lastappeared = {{amol|18}}}}'''Piava''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of unknown [[Ajah]]. She has a [[Warder]] who is not an [[Asha'man]].

== Activities ==
She fought with [[Egwene al'Vere]] at the [[Last Battle]]. Her Warder and [[Sleete]] guarded the area where Egwene, [[Silviana Brehon]], and [[Gawyn Trakand]] were fighting in one of the early battles.

== Ajah ==
Because she has a Warder who is not an Asha'man, she is not [[Red Ajah]]. It is also unlikely that she is [[White Ajah|White]] because few of them have Warders and probably not [[Yellow Ajah|Yellow]] as well because the majority of the Ajah was in [[Mayene]].

== Trivia ==
She is named after Pia Maria Vaajakallio, a Finnish fan who was one of a number of people involved in a competition to have a character named after them.<ref>[https://www.theoryland.com/intvmain.php?i=639 Characters named after fans]</ref>
